summary: Helus Pharma Inc., a Toronto-based clinical-stage biopharma listed on Nasdaq and Cboe Canada, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a news release dated November 3, 2026. The release announces only that CEO Michael Halstead will participate in a fireside chat at the Guggenheim Healthcare Innovation Conference in Boston on November 9, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. EDT, with a live webcast and replay. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is a routine investor-relations scheduling notice; there is no deal or risk-arb angle to watch.
